set.body:
Type: implementation task (sub-task of F02.3)
Work key: F02.3.1
Parent: F02.3 (bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27)
Plan: docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md (transition table, public API contract), ADR 003 (recovery)

Scope: grantRuntime and the runtime isolation check admit INSERT/UPDATE(payload) on organization records and runtime INSERT of governed event kinds through row security, while CreateLab, DisablePrincipal, OrganizationGenesis, credential and recovery events, bootstrap fields, lifecycle columns and durability mode stay operator-only.
Acceptance: (1) a fresh runtime login can execute a governed command end to end; (2) the same login is refused operator event kinds, bootstrap and credential writes by row security, not only by application code; (3) the startup isolation check still rejects a runtime with operator powers.
set.title: F02.3.1: Extend the reviewed runtime privilege profile to governed organization commands
